summary: GO. Both blockers from the first go/no-go (e7e5935c) are fixed, and every gate passes on dde3c322. M1: lesson 1 'Welcome home, Sensei' and Hikari's line in its scene now say 'Open the Menu and tap Background…'. The Menu sheet's head really has a BACKGROUND button, and it opens the Lobby Background picker, where you choose both who keeps you company and the backdrop. No '‹ ›' is left anywhere in src. M2: a locked bond tile's tooltip and toast now say 'spend time with her and give gifts in the City to unlock', and the bond theme 'Café Date' is now 'Café Afternoon'. There is no player-facing romantic 'date'/'dating' wording left in src. The patch note picked up both low notes (L1 'every chapter', L2 top-bar currencies). The delta e7e5935c..dde3c322 is 7 files, +15/-14, copy, comments and one docs note only. The full test suite, sim id, COOP_PROTOCOL, build, secret scan and the smoke, home and Halloween e2e all pass. A 29-screen spot check on a fresh save and a mid save at 844x390 and 1280x720 had 0 console errors, 0 page errors and 0 failed local requests. Only low notes remain, none blocking.

findings.title: Header comments in lobbyArt.js and bgPicker.js still quote 'date a girl … more intimate background', and one mentions the old picture button
findings.detail: src/data/lobbyArt.js:1-3 and src/ui/lobby/bgPicker.js:1-3 open with the owner's original words: 'eventually when you date a girl and gift her stuff in the city … you'll get a more intimate background'. bgPicker.js:3 also says the picker is 'Opened from the Menu Tab and the small picture button on the lobby'; the Quiet Home has no picture button. These are comments, never shown to players, and the minified build strips them. They are unchanged since before v0.1.53, so they do not block. But the release's own commit says design comments 'steer future writers', and these two steer the opposite way to HANDOFF §6. A later tidy could paraphrase the quote ('as her bond grows through time together and gifts, more of her memories unlock') and say 'Opened from Menu › Background'.
findings.evidence: sed -n 1,3p src/data/lobbyArt.js; sed -n 1,6p src/ui/lobby/bgPicker.js; neither file's lines 1-3 are in git diff e7e5935c dde3c322

notes_for_owner: Good to ship. The two wording fixes from last time are in and look right on screen. Hikari's first lesson now says to open the Menu and tap Background, and that button is really there. A locked memory in the background picker now says 'spend time with her and give gifts in the City', and the café memory is called 'Café Afternoon'. Nothing else changed since the last check apart from the patch note, which now says 'every chapter of the story' and mentions that top bars show only the currencies each screen uses. All the tests pass, battles and co-op are unchanged (same sim id, same co-op version), the build is clean with no secrets in it, and I saw no errors on new or mid-game saves at phone or desktop size. One small optional tidy for later: two code comments still quote the original 'date a girl' idea. Players never see them, but rewording them would keep future writers on the friendly-teacher track.
